string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: In the cross, the line below the chosen item is bigger (18) and far items are more visible, to read from the sofa
Pressing OK gives the icon a light squeeze; if the app doesn’t open, the cross says “Couldn’t open”
Holding an arrow, the cross runs faster with fewer clicks; changing group feels firmer
Each group has its own note (Watch, Listen, Play…) and sounds are softer at night

string-array.name: roteiro_perguntas
string-array.item: From the sofa, can you read the line below the chosen item and see the items at the ends?
Pressing OK on an app, does the icon give a light squeeze before opening?
Holding ▼ in Apps, does the list run fast without a burst of clicks?
Changing group with ◀ ▶, does each group sound a different note?
